wings_fairy.motion: Fine ribbed gauze wings flex at their backplate as Cheese walks; their stitched tips settle at rest.

fairy_wings.motion: Scalloped moth-wing panels sway from a small shoulder harness; embroidered eyespots remain sewn in place.

angel_wings.motion: Layered costume feathers jostle on a fitted backplate and tuck close when Cheese rests.

bat_wings.motion: Fabric membranes crease between their stitched ribs as the back-mounted costume sways with each step.

valentine_cupid_wings.motion: Heart-shaped feather panels bounce lightly at a ribboned harness; their short tips settle against the back.

halo.motion: A thin brass ring quivers on its visible headband wire as Cheese walks; a small highlight moves along the rim.

halo_angel.motion: A beaded double ring tilts gently on its headband support while the tiny sunburst stays attached.

devil_horns.motion: Two curved stitched horns follow the fitted headband; soft tips wobble slightly with each waddle.
